title: What's behind today's chip-equipment moves? Coherent popped 10%premarket on a Reuters report, then faded.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Coherent rose about 3% this morning after popping as much as 10%  
premarket on a Reuters report. Meanwhile, the toolmakers behind every  
AI chip are getting stacked up: Applied Materials vs Dell, ASML vs  
Alphabet, and Lam vs the SMH chip ETF. Lam itself is down 20% in a  
month. Today's overview of the toolmakers behind AI is below.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Coherent (COHR)\*\* — Coherent Corp shares rose from Monday's close  
of $203.43 to $209.72, a gain of +3.09%, in regular-session trading  
Tuesday morning after climbing as much as \~+10% in premarket before  
fading. The catalyst was a Reuters report, published before the open,  
that the Trump administration will press ahead with an FCC ban on  
imports of new Chinese optical transceivers despite lobbying by  
Amazon, Google, Meta and...
